name: Elevate Uranium Ltd
summary: Elevate Uranium Ltd, headquartered in West Perth and incorporated in 1978, explores for and evaluates uranium. It operates projects in Namibia, such as Koppies, Hirabeb, Marenica and Namib IV, and in Australia, where it fully owns the Angela, Thatcher Soak, Oobagooma and Minerva areas and takes part in joint ventures. It took its present name in May 2021, having been known as Marenica Energy.
